title: Rich Chocolate Cheesecake
description: Recipe video above. A decadent chocolate cheesecake with a chocolate Oreo base, a dreamy creamy chocolate filling, a layer of chocolate ganache and finished with whipped cream and chocolate shavings. And if that all sounds amazing to you, wait for it... it's NO BAKE and NO GELATINE! Chocolate sets the filling for us, how good is that!It's intensely chocolatey and almost indecently luxurious but has just enough cheesecake tang to balance the richness. Slices beautifully yet melts in your mouth! IMPORTANT: Has to be made with 70% cocoa chocolate in order to set properly. Anything less and it will set softer. Gluten-free - See Note 9.
ingredients: 140g / 4.9oz Oreo cookies ((14 oreos, 1 standard Australian sleeve, Note 1))
200g / 6.5 oz 70% cocoa chocolate (, pretty finely chopped (Note 2))
2 tbsp cocoa powder (, no need to sift)
2 1/2 tbsp boiling hot water (, for blooming cocoa)
1 cup thickened cream / heavy cream (or a full-fat whipping cream, fridge cold)
500g / 1 lb cream cheese (, softened (block form, Note 3))
1/2 cup thickened cream / heavy cream (, or pure cream 35 - 40% fat (Note 5))
75 g / 2.7 oz 70% cocoa chocolate (finely chopped even if using buttons, callets or chips (Note 2))
1 cup thickened cream / heavy cream (, fridge cold (for whipping))
Any milk chocolate bar (, or leftover 70% or dark chocolate, shaved using a vegetable peeler (Note 2))
instructions: Inverted pan base - Flip the base of a 20cm / 8" springform pan upside down – this makes it easier to remove the finished cheesecake without the lip in the way. Very lightly butter the pan base, then press on a square sheet of baking paper. Clip the pan sides onto the base, letting the excess paper stick out the sides (for easy removal later).
Line with high sides - Butter and line the pan sides with more baking paper, making them about 1cm / 0.4" higher than the rim. (Note 6)
Blitz cookies - Roughly break up Oreos with hands and place in food processor. Blitz until they become fine crumbs. Add melted butter, then blitz again until combined.
Press into pan - Transfer crumbs into prepared pan, pressing evenly and firmly on to the base only (I use the underside of a straight-sided, flat-bottomed cup measure to do this).

Melt chocolate - Put the chopped chocolate into a heatproof bowl and microwave in 20 second increments, stirring in between, until melted and smooth. Set aside to cool for 5 minutes so it is lukewarm but still fluid. If it's hot, it will melt the whipped cream and deflate the filling.
Bloom cocoa - Whisk the cocoa and the hot water until smooth. This makes the flavour of the cocoa bloom! Set aside.
Whip the cream until stiff peaks form (2 - 3 minutes on high). Goal: upright Santa hats, not floppy elf hats!
Whip cream cheese - In a separate large bowl (no need to clean the beaters), beat the cream cheese and sugar for 2 minutes on high until fluffy and smooth.
Add vanilla and beat just to mix it through.
Make it chocolate! Add melted chocolate and bloomed cocoa, beat until it is mixed through, stopping to scrape down the sides of the bowl as needed.

Fold/beat in cream - Add one third of the whipped cream to the cream cheese mixture and beat it through just until combined. Then add the rest of the cream and use the beater to mix it in until you can no longer see streaks of cream.
Pour into cake pan - Pour the mixture onto the Oreo crust base and smooth the surface.

Fridge 6 hours & ganache - Transfer to the fridge for at least 2 hours. Then pour over the ganache (directions below) and spread evenly over the surface (rotate pan to spread). Then refrigerate for another 6 hours+ to let the cheesecake fully set. (Note 7)

Remove cheesecake - Release the sides of the springform pan. Use the paper to slide the cheesecake off the base onto a serving platter. Peel the paper off the sides, then slide the paper out from under the cake.

Whip cream - Place the cream, sugar and vanilla in a bowl. Beat on high for 2 minutes until softly whipped. (See here for make-ahead stabilised whipped cream option - Note 8). Then pipe swirls around the border and sprinkle all over with shaved chocolate, if using.
Serve - Cut the cheesecake into slices and serve, fridge cold! An extra dollop of whipped cream on the side would never go astray.
Heat cream until hot but not boiling. Pour over finely chopped chocolate, leave 5 min, stir until smooth. Bang to remove bubbles. Pour over cheesecake.
